reference_title: Soil Stabilization and Modification for Pavements

sections.title: C-1 Referenced Publications
sections.summary: Lists the DoD/UFC, AASHTO, ACI, and ASTM publications referenced throughout this UFC. Publication dates are intentionally omitted; unless otherwise specified, the most recent edition of each referenced publication applies (per Sec 1-6).
sections.body: DOD: UFC 3-220-08FA (Engineering Use of Geotextiles), UFC 3-250-01 (Paving Design for Roads and Parking Areas), UFC 3-250-03 (Standard Practice Manual for Flexible Pavements), UFC 3-260-02 (Pavement Design for Airfields) -- available at https://www.wbdg.org/ffc/dod/unified-facilities-criteria-ufc. AASHTO: M288 (Standard Specification for Geosynthetic Specification for Highway Applications). ACI: 230.1R (Report on Soil Cement). ASTM: C33 (Concrete Aggregates), C150 (Portland Cement), C593 (Fly Ash and Other Pozzolans for Use with Lime for Soil Stabilization), C977 (Quicklime and Hydrated Lime for Soil Stabilization), C1580 (Water-Soluble Sulfate in Soil), D558 (Moisture-Density Relations of Soil-Cement Mixtures), D559 (Wetting and Drying Compacted Soil-Cement Mixtures), D560 (Freezing and Thawing Compacted Soil-Cement Mixtures), D698 (Laboratory Compaction Characteristics of Soil Using Standard Effort), D1556 (Density and Unit Weight of Soil in Place by Sand-Cone Method), D1557 (Laboratory Compaction Characteristics of Soil Using Modified Effort), D1632 (Making and Curing Soil-Cement Compression and Flexure Test Specimens), D1633 (Compressive Strength of Molded Soil-Cement Cylinders), D2166/D2166M (Unconfined Compressive Strength of Cohesive Soil), D2216 (Laboratory Determination of Water/Moisture Content of Soil and Rock by Mass), D2487 (Classification of Soils for Engineering Purposes, USCS), D3551 (Laboratory Preparation of Soil-Lime Mixtures Using Mechanical Mixer), D4318 (Liquid Limit, Plastic Limit, and Plasticity Index of Soils), D4546 (One-Dimensional Swell or Collapse of Soils), D6276 (Using pH to Estimate the Soil-Lime Proportion Requirement for Soil Stabilization), D6913/D6913M (Particle-Size Distribution of Soils Using Sieve Analysis), D6927 (Marshall Stability and Flow of Asphalt Mixtures), D6938 (In-Place Density and Water Content of Soil and Soil-Aggregate by Nuclear Methods), D7928 (Particle-Size Distribution of Fine-Grained Soils Using Sedimentation/Hydrometer Analysis).
key_points: DoD/UFC companion documents: UFC 3-220-08FA (geotextiles), UFC 3-250-01/3-250-03 (roads/flexible pavements), UFC 3-260-02 (airfields)
AASHTO M288 governs the geosynthetic fabric used in the cement-stabilized-base bond breaker (Sec 2-1.3.1)
ACI 230.1R (Report on Soil Cement) supports organic-matter interference guidance (Sec 2-1.2.1)

ASTM test methods span classification (D2487, D4318, D6913, D7928), compaction (D698, D1557), soil-cement/soil-lime prep and testing (D558-D560, D1632-D1633, D2166, D3551), sulfate/pH (C1580, D6276), and durability/nuclear methods (D2216, D6938)
Publication dates are intentionally omitted from all citations in this UFC; the most recent edition of each applies unless otherwise specified
